description.value: Black Swan Pub is a two-generation family-owned neighbourhood pub and liquor store nestled in the village of Shawnigan Lake on Vancouver Island. It offers a full English pub experience with a daily kitchen, weekly food specials, and an on-site liquor store with delivery service. As a long-standing community institution, it provides a welcoming sit-down meal option for touring cyclists passing through the Shawnigan Lake area.

address.value: 2890 Shawnigan Lake Road, Shawnigan Lake, BC
